name: Triacs and SCRs
summary: Triacs and SCRs that switch and dim AC loads, in dimmers, speed controllers and appliances.
identify: Three-legged TO-220 parts marked BTA16, BT136, BT137 or BTA41, often on heatsinks, in dimmers, drills, washing machines, fans and heaters; SCRs also in battery chargers and treadmill controllers.
test: The two main terminals should read open both ways on a meter. A short means it’s dead.
